explicit_exclusions: No doctrine or classical correctness ratification.
No production population, deployment, runtime health, expert-domain acceptance or empirical answer-quality claim.
Manual review establishes source-local specificity and internal semantic coherence only.

method.population: All 182 planner-addressable SCUs in the pinned capability knowledge snapshot.
method.automated_census: Checked every SCU for editorial status, non-empty descriptions/domains/concepts/intents/outputs, resolvable editorial references, descriptor/declaration URI membership, bound concepts, valid edge endpoints and non-empty edge source references.
method.manual_sample: Within each L0-L5 stratum, sort by scu_id and inspect positions 0, floor(n/3), floor(2n/3), and n-1. This yields 24 deterministic samples and includes catalog-derived and authored semantic declarations.
manual_questions: Does the description identify the capability's actual evidence or operation rather than repeat its label?
Do domains, concepts, intents and outputs cohere with that description and layer responsibility?
Do limitations, pagination gaps and safety boundaries remain explicit where material?
Does the graph state cite authored evidence or explicitly disposition isolation without inventing an edge?
